researchLog.message: Road Channels 1 research complete. Allows two one-way Road channels per direction. Each carries one item every five seconds; fluids cannot use roads.
Ore Separation research complete. Unlocks Ore Separation recipes and systems.
Mineral Recovery research complete. Unlocks Slag washing, Recovered Brick and Recovered Iron. Slag washing needs local Water.
Waste Handling research complete. Unlocks Waste Handling.
Mithril Refining research complete. Unlocks Mythril Gear and Mythril Wire in the Refiner, Mythril Plate in the Smelter, and the Separation Furnace.
Fluid Routing research complete. Unlocks Fluid Routing recipes and systems.

Map Node research complete. Awards 1 Map Point. First 9 purchases cost 5 Simple. Each later ten-purchase phase adds a core tier and raises the price by 1 every two purchases: 6–10 each through Basic, then 11–15, 16–20, 21–25 and 26–30. After purchase 59, prices rise by 1 every five purchases to 42 each. Locked cores are not required.
